sources.title: BOT IT risk supervision notification 5/2566, official Thai text

limitations: Curated partial clause coverage only. The baseline is an assessment target, never a national security grade or a certification decision.
2023 notification supersedes the 2019 notification identified in section 3. The Thai text and later circulars control applicability; translation and current consolidation require competent review.
